message.content:
**CLOSE MATCH**

The clone is a very high-fidelity reproduction of the original. Only minor, low-severity visual residuals were detected:

*   **Sidebar Bottom Spacing (Low):** In the original (Image 1), there is a noticeable vertical gap between the "FREE" usage card and the "Sign out" link at the bottom of the left sidebar. In the clone (Image 2), this gap is significantly reduced or absent, causing the footer elements to sit closer to the bottom edge.
*   **"Pricing & Plan" Icon Color (Low):** The icon to the left of the active "Pricing & Plan" menu item in the sidebar appears slightly more saturated or darker in the clone compared to the softer gold/yellow tone in the original.
*   **Main Content Vertical Positioning (Low):** The entire main content area (pricing cards and FAQ section) appears shifted slightly lower in the viewport in the clone relative to the header, whereas in the original it sits slightly higher. This is likely a side effect of the sidebar height/layout difference mentioned above.
